text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a weekend afternoon with no particular 
plans, as I was killing time in front of 
the stationââ

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>! What perfect timing! Um, this 
might be sudden, but――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Do you like idols?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
An idol! A sparkling, energetic performer 
who sings and dances!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I actually have one spare 
ticket for a concert I highly recommend...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, would you care to join 
me?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! It is an honor to accompany you. I'm 
certain you will enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a recommendation from event 
producer Light Hello, the live concert was 
a massive success――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, that was so wonderful! I was 
moved to tears~~!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And get this! The girl in the center and I 
totally locked eyes!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Look at me! She even gave me a huge wink! 
Aaah~ it's no good, I'm falling for her 
even harder~!
choice_data_list:
Even though your seats were pretty far 
back...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about?! Listen up, 
the single most important thing when 
watching a live show is――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's "the power of positive thinking"! 
Yes, it is!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
It's all about believing it was fanservice 
just for me! A steadfast conviction that 
my cheers reached her!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch the cast's "power of passion" 
with my own "power of conviction."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning Lives are wonderful, but idol 
concerts give me so much energy too... I 
just love them!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorry, I got way too excited. 
Whenever it comes to concerts, I just get 
completely carried away.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Really? Oh, thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer, if you wouldn't mind.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to come with me to another 
live concert or event? I have plenty of 
other recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be really fun if we 
could share our thoughts after the 
event...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I really had fun today too. Let's do this 
again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Light Hello animatedly shared 
her thoughts on the live show, making for 
a lively and cheerful walk home.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I-I see! You're busy too, aren't you, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm so sorry for springing that on 
you out of nowhere! Well then, um, excuse 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I parted ways with Light 
Hello...
